# Tron Inc. Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


by[\[email protected\]](https://srmentertainment.com/author/chrissimplythebestdigital-com/)


| Nov 10, 2026


|[Press Releases](https://srmentertainment.com/category/press-releases/)


**Company reports $39.4 million in net income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, representing 203% year-over-year growth**


**Digital asset holdings increase to $257.8 million, while nine-month staking income more than quadruples to $9.5 million**


**Subsequent election as a TRON Super Representative expands participation in Tron infrastructure**


Winter Park, Florida, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Tron Inc. (Nasdaq: TRON), the largest publicly traded holder of TRON (TRX) tokens, today announced its financial results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026.


The Company reported net income of $39.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of approximately 203% compared to $13.0 million for the corresponding period in 2025. During the third quarter of 2026, net income reached $14.9 million, an increase of approximately 22% compared to $12.2 million for the corresponding period in 2025.


Total assets increased to $275.2 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to $211.4 million at December 31, 2025, representing growth of approximately 30%. The Company’s digital asset investments increased to $257.8 million.


The results demonstrate the Company’s expanding digital asset holdings, increasing staking-related income and improving performance in its legacy operating business. Subsequent to quarter-end, Tron Inc. achieved an important strategic milestone with its election as one of the TRON Network’s 27 Super Representatives, advancing its strategy to participate directly in network infrastructure and pursue additional sources of network rewards.


The Company reported approximately $9.51 million in unrealized staking income for the first nine months of 2026 compared to $2.30 million for the corresponding period in 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, unrealized staking income increased to approximately $3.18 million, an increase of approximately 41% from the corresponding period in 2025.


The Company views staking as an important component of its digital asset treasury strategy, enabling participation in the TRON network while generating additional token-denominated economic benefits.


Unlike unrealized gains resulting from changes in digital asset market prices, staking income reflects rewards associated with the Company’s participation in Tron Network staking activities.


“During the first nine months of 2026, we generated more than $39 million in reported net income, expanded our digital asset investments to approximately $258 million, and more than quadrupled our reported staking income compared to the same period last year. Our strategy is expanding beyond holding digital assets to providing additional value-add services for Tron network. Our election as a TRON Super Representative in October represents a initial step in positioning Tron Inc. for further infrastructure integration within the TRON ecosystem” said Rich Miller, Tron Inc. CEO.


**About Tron Inc.**


Tron Inc. is a publicly traded company pioneering integrated treasury strategies. As the public company with the largest TRON (TRX) tokens holdings, Tron Inc. is committed to transparency, and the adoption of decentralized finance for long-term value creation. Tron Inc. was elected as a Super Representative on the Tron Network in October 2026. In addition, through its wholly owned subsidiary, the Company designs, develops, and manufactures custom merchandise which includes toys and souvenirs for the world’s largest theme parks and other entertainment venues, including Walt Disney Parks and Resorts, Universal Parks and Destinations, United Parks and Resorts SeaWorld, Six Flags and other attractions.. Many of the Company’s products are based on award winning multi-billion-dollar entertainment franchises that are featured in popular movies and books.
